The Distance Is Not Our Destination.

No more checking flight dates.

No more counting days until we meet.

No more saying goodnight through a screen.

One day, we will simply be together.

Until then, I will keep working, growing and choosing you.

Every day. Every year. Forever.

Thank you for being my favourite part of every day.
